pilot.budget_body:
At every LL you get +1 point of skills, talents, mech skills and licenses. GRIT = LL ÷ 2 (rounded up) and is added to mech HP, saves and attacks. A CORE bonus is granted at every even level.
  • Skill points: 4 + LL
  • Talent points: 3 + LL
  • Mech skills: 2 + LL
  • Licenses: LL
  • CORE bonuses: LL ÷ 2 (round down)
